feature_blocks.title: Prepare each listing with a clearer base before publishing
feature_blocks.text: Upload product photos and add the essential details such as brand, size, measurements or price. Vinbot helps turn that information into a cleaner draft so you can review it before the first listing goes live.
points: Open AI drafts and prepare an item using its real photos and details: brand, size, measurements and price.
In settings, fill in Store name if you want its hashtags included; leave it blank to use only item hashtags.
Fill in About your business if you want the AI to use that information in descriptions and keywords; review and edit the draft before publishing.
feature_blocks.closing: Replace the example values with your shop details or leave optional fields blank. Always review generated text before publishing.

feature_blocks.title: Keep your items active without relying on daily memory
feature_blocks.text: When you manage many listings, renewing items manually ends up taking a huge share of the day. Vinbot lets you define a renewal routine so this repetitive task stays organised.
points: Open Settings > Preferences and locate Item auto-renewal.
Turn on Enable auto-renewal and choose a frequency: daily, every 2 or 3 days, weekly, fortnightly, monthly or manual.
Set the daily limit per account and enable the accounts to include under Accounts to renew.
Search or filter the products and select the ones to renew; Select all and None apply to the item selection.
feature_blocks.closing: Only selected items from enabled accounts are renewed. The daily limit applies per account; choose a cautious frequency and limit.

feature_blocks.title: Use the interest without writing the same message over and over
feature_blocks.text: When someone shows interest in one of your articles, answering quickly can be useful, but repeating the same process dozens of times consumes time. Vinbot lets you configure responses to likes and keep this part of the workflow more organised.
points: Open the Automatic like response section.
Turn the Enable automatic like response switch on or off.
Check the feature status: while it is active, the configured message is sent automatically when someone favourites one of your items.
feature_blocks.closing: Before enabling automatic replies, make sure the configured message is appropriate: it will be sent when someone favourites an item.

feature_blocks.title: Negotiate by your rules, not by random discounts
feature_blocks.text: Each item has a margin and every seller has a different way of negotiating. Vinbot helps apply a coherent logic to offers and conversations, based on the limits you have defined.
points: Open Negotiator bot and review today’s negotiations, average discount and pending replies.
Use Master bot control to enable or disable all of its features at once.
Set Conversational replies and Negotiation bot separately, depending on whether you want product questions answered or offers negotiated.
Review activity for new conversations and negotiations.
feature_blocks.closing: Configuration changes take effect immediately for new conversations and negotiations.

feature_blocks.title: Decide how you want to negotiate before the conversation begins
feature_blocks.text: Automation only makes sense when it reflects how you sell. This section lets you define a negotiation strategy before activating it: how much margin you want to keep, which discounts you consider, and how Vinbot should behave in each case.
points: Open Negotiation strategy and enable Starting point strategy if you want the first counteroffer to apply a discount.
Adjust the initial discount with the visible control and choose Conservative, Moderate or Aggressive.
Set the number of negotiation rounds and the maximum discount limits in percent and euros.
Enable Send a message with each offer only if you also want the bot to message the buyer when it sends an offer.
feature_blocks.closing: Set the limits first: when you configure both a percentage and a euro maximum, the more restrictive limit applies. Changes affect new negotiations.

feature_blocks.title: Keep an eye on what is active, pending and needs review
feature_blocks.text: From a single view you can check the status of your catalogue and quickly see which items are active, which are still in draft and which listings need action.
points: Open Inventory and review totals for active items, drafts, hidden, sold and reserved items.
Check each item card for its status, account and details; use Find duplicates or Sync if you need those functions.
To relist an item, use Relist on its card and verify that it is the correct item first.
feature_blocks.closing: The screenshot contains demo items. In your account, check the item details and account before syncing or relisting.

faq.question: What can Vinbot do?
faq.answer: Vinbot brings together tools to prepare listings, keep your items active, respond to buyer interest and configure automations according to how you sell.

faq.question: Do I need to enable every feature?
faq.answer: No. You can activate only the tools that fit your workflow and leave the rest off until you are ready to try them.

faq.question: Can I review the setup before activating it?
faq.answer: Yes. Vinbot is designed so you can define rules, margins and messages before activating any automation.

faq.question: Is Vinbot affiliated with Vinted?
faq.answer: No. Vinbot is an independent service and is not affiliated with, associated with or endorsed by Vinted.

faq.question: How do I request access?
faq.answer: Click “Request early access” and complete the process directly from Vinbot.

faq.question: What languages are available?
faq.answer: Vinbot is available in Spanish, Catalan, English and French.
